standard.summary: 仅用于 Loss 加权退火余弦。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Used by the loss-weighted annealed cosine only.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 仅用于 Loss 加权退火余弦。未锁定或触发保护上限时，每步至少推进多少余弦相位，避免后期完全停住。

advanced_en.principle: Only for the loss-weighted annealing cosine. When unlocked or after the guard cap triggers, the minimum cosine phase advanced per step, keeping late training from stalling completely.
